content:
Are you seeing all the expected emails in the shared mailbox, just in the wrong sort order, or are emails missing? If missing, are they all from the same account?

1. Check you have date selected as the sort criteria. It's the icon next to the magnifying glass. 2. Perform a full account sync. 3. Check required folders from each account are configured to display within the unified Inbox. To do this ...

a. Select an account from the side bar with your folders listed. b. Tap manage folders from the bottom of the list. c. Tap a folder name (e.g Inbox). d. Check "Unify" is enabled.
